subject: OTELLYTICS POC - post-call recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Desai <samir@otellytics.com>
Cc: Lina Torres <lina.torres@otellytics.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: OTELLYTICS POC - post-call recap & next steps

Hi Samir / Lina,

Thanks again for the call today — great to learn more about how Otellytics wants to use embeddings for telemetry correlation and faster incident triage. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the POC scheduled: 

Summary / success criteria (proposed)
- Ingest ~7 days of representative telemetry (logs + traces) and embed key fields (message, stack, error code).
- Demonstrate median query latency <= 150ms for top-5 query types under a 10 qps traffic profile.
- Achieve precision@10 >= 0.65 on your labeled similarity set for triage matching.
- Show integration with your Slack workflow (alert -> suggested triage runbook) in a sandbox.

Proposed timeline
- Week 0 (next week): kickoff, sample data handoff, security questionnaire items.
- Week 1: ingestion pipeline + baseline embeddings + initial evaluation.
- Week 2: tune retrieval + latency/load testing + Slack integration demo.

Owners / asks from Otellytics
- Samir: confirm success criteria above (or send edits).
- Lina: share sample telemetry export (anonymized) and a small labeled eval set (CSV with ground truth IDs).
- Provide an allowlist IP or temporary S3 read access for ingestion.

What we’ll deliver
- A scoped POC SOW and scoring rubric, a hosted POC environment, and a short deck with results.

Attachments: POC_Scoping_Template.xlsx, redwood-data-security.pdf

Can you confirm the proposed kickoff window (Tue 2026-06-16 / Wed 2026-06-17) and whether the sample export will be available before then?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0122

From: Samir Desai <samir@otellytics.com>

Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 18:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OTELLYTICS POC - post-call recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Lina and I are aligned on the goals; a few clarifications from our side: 

- The labeled eval set is small (≈500 pairs) and we can provide that by EOD Friday (2026-06-12).
- For privacy we’ll provide an anonymized S3 export with presigned read links (we’ll send an allowlist too).
- On tooling: we want a Slack demo but also a simple REST endpoint we can call from our staging environment.
- Security: SOC2 report is required for sign-off. I saw the redwood-data-security.pdf — can you confirm which additional evidence (e.g., encryption in transit config, retention policies) you can supply quickly?

Kickoff: Wed 2026-06-17 works best on our side if that’s still available. We’d like Dev to join the kickoff to go over ingestion details.

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Platform Engineering | Otellytics
samir@otellytics.com | +1 212-555-0188

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Samir Desai <samir@otellytics.com>
Cc: Lina Torres <lina.torres@otellytics.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OTELLYTICS POC - post-call recap & next steps

Hi all,

Quick tech note / plan from the SE side so we’re aligned for kickoff on 2026-06-17: 

1) Ingest plan
- Presigned S3 read is easiest. We’ll run a quick schema check and a small sample ingest (~10k records) to validate parsers.
- Please include a representative mix of logs/traces and a few enriched fields (service, span_id, error_code).

2) Environment & perf
- We’ll provision a dedicated POC instance (single-node GPU for embeddings + CPU for retrieval) and run load tests to validate 10 qps target.
- If latency is higher than expected we’ll try 8-bit quantized model variants to reduce latency/cost.

3) Evaluation plan
- Dev/Redwood will run embedding generation and compute precision@10 against your labeled CSV.
- We’ll produce a short report with metrics (p@1/p@5/p@10, median latency, 95th latency) and run the Slack integration demo.

4) Security / evidence
- We can provide: SOC2 summary (redacted), encryption in transit config, transient credentialing notes, and our data deletion SLA. The full SOC2 report is under NDA; Samir, if you want it we can share via our secure portal.

I attached an example ingest config (ingest-config-example.json) to show expected fields. I’ll be on the kickoff call on 6/17 and can walk through the ingest step-by-step.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Desai <samir@otellytics.com>
Cc: Lina Torres <lina.torres@otellytics.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OTELLYTICS POC - weekly status & confirmation for kickoff (6/17)

Hi Samir / Lina — quick weekly touch to keep things moving and confirm tomorrow’s kickoff. Short status and checklist below: 

Completed this week
- Redwoods: prepared POC instance and shared scoping template + security summary.
- Otellytics: committed to labeled eval set delivery (thanks) and presigned S3 approach.

Open items (please confirm)
- Labeled eval CSV delivery: ETA Fri 2026-06-12 (Samir confirmed). Please confirm it has a header with fields: query_id, ground_truth_id, similarity_label.
- Presigned S3 export & allowlist: please send link and IP allowlist before kickoff (preferably by EOD today).
- Kickoff time: proposing 10:00 AM PT tomorrow 2026-06-17 — please confirm or propose alternate.

POC scoring rubric (high level)
- Functionality: pass if precision@10 >= 0.65 on labeled set.
- Performance: pass if median latency <= 150ms under 10 qps.
- Integration: pass if Slack workflow demo is functional and can be triggered from your staging alerts.

Next steps after kickoff
- Day 1: validate data ingest and baseline embeddings.
- Day 3-5: tuning and latency tests, Slack integration.
- End of Week 2: results report + recommendations.

Attachments: POC_Scoping_Template.xlsx, ingest-config-example.json
Related link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/OTEL-2026-0421

If you’d like, Rachel from our CS team can join the wrap-up demo to talk handoff and success criteria for production.

Thanks — please confirm the checklist items and kickoff time.

Best,
Marissa Cole
